newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy downgrades 1996 GDP forecast to 0.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy downgrades 1996 GDP forecast to 0.8 pct.

text.p: The government said it was now expecting Italian gross domestic product (GDP) to grow by just 0.8 percent this year against a previous forecast of 1.2 percent growth.
However it said in an official document that GDP growth in 1997 could still reach the old target of two percent.
The official document confirmed the previously given average annual inflation target for 1996 of 3.9 percent and said the 2.5 percent target for 1997 "appears possible".
It said the public sector deficit target of 113 trillion lire for this year could overshoot by up to 10 trillion lire. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
